notes.content: [p]Fixed the Ronin set description, which was displaying incorrect Wound and Weakness values.[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - 09/18/2025
notes.content: [p]Fixed a bug that caused Liz's first Passive Ability to have infinite uses.[/p]

notes.title: Patch - 09/18/2025
notes.content:
[h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Strange Reptilians now have Poisonous 5 instead of Poisonous 6.[/p][/*][*][p]Shroomies no longer attack on the same turn they spawned if they didn't spawn on the player's turn.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the Hard Path option at the Crossroads event to give better rewards and make the enemies stronger.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed some texts to improve their clarity or fix mistakes.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Balance[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Buffed the Ronin set to now also give (10%/20%/30%) Counterattack.[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed the damage based on Max Health from the Taboo set from (3%/5%) to (5%/8%).[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed the Thorns gained from the Ironclad set from (2/3/4) to (3/4/5).[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed the extra stacks applied for negatives Statuses from the Royal set from (3/5) to (4/6).[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed the extra Areas from the Villager set from (10/20) to (15/25).[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed the Swiftness given by the Sylvan set (10/40/50) to (5/30/35).[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed the Hex applied with the Fae set from (5/10/15) to (4/8/12).[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed the Wounds applied by the Mirrored Mythic set (activated by Unbreakable Mirror) from 10 to 20.[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed the Armor given by the Unbreakable Mirror from 8 to 10.[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed the Swiftness gained when attacking with the Speedster Mythic set (activated by the Seven-league Boots) from 10% to 5%.[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed the execution range with the Blasphemous Mythic set (activated by the Godslayer Dagger) from 40% of the target Max Health to 25%.[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed the permanent Damage Amplification gained when attacking with the Psychopomp Mythic set (activated by the Soul Harvester) from 2% to 1%.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the stats given by the Ranger Jerkin (from the Sylvan set) from (5 Armor. 15% Dodge, 15% Swiftness) to (5 Armor, 15% Dodge, 10% Swiftness, 10% Counterattack).[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked stats given by the Wolf Ring (from the Beast Set) from 12% Swiftness to 12% Damage Amplification.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked stats given by the Stolen Necklace (from the Saltwater Set) from 5% Swiftness and 5% Damage Amplification to 12% Swiftness.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the Survival Instinct skill completely:

[i][b]Old[/b]
You gain 4% Damage amplification for every missing point of health.[/i]

[i][b]New[/b]
The first time you lose health in each combat, gain 50% Damage Amplification. If your health is below 50%, gain 100% Damage Amplification instead.
[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Buffed the Rough Skin skill to deal extra damage based on the Max Health of the enemy.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the health lost with the Lord Mythic set (activated by Helm of Conquest) to now always trigger after every other End of Round effect. That means it now works with the Iron Will skill.[/p][/*][*][p]Liz's first Passive Ability no longer benefits from the Villager set to prevent a exploit where you could activate the set, spend the rerolls and then unequip it.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bugfixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Now the options from the Remains of a hero event correctly disappear after skipping it.[/p][/*][*][p]Now the Emergency Healing skill correctly benefits from the Iron Will skill.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where clicking an item would sometimes upgrade it when loading a game left with Hammer option from the Shrine event selected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a variety of rare bugs related to Liz's first Passive Ability.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix - 10/09/2025
notes.content: [p]Fixed a bug caused by the last patch that prevented Guard to regenerate Barriers on the Incarnate bossfight.[/p]

notes.title: Patch - 09/10/2025
notes.content:
[h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Now all the skills become visible after acquiring the first skill point.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the likelihood of items dropped to be from one of you active sets.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased experience gained after losing a run.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a skip button to the Remains of a hero event.[/p][/*][*][p]Now you can use the Philosopher's Stone while at full health to remove negative Statuses.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed mistakes and typos in some texts.[/p][/*][/list][h3]
[b]Balance[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The Ironclad set had a big design problem: it did nothing once you lost all your Barriers. That meant that it was powerful with skills that generated enough Barriers to sustain long fights but very weak otherwise. To solve this, we have reworked it to no longer deal increased damage for each broken Barrier and instead give you Thorns whenever a Barrier is broken.

[b]Old[/b][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]Enemies breaking your Barriers receive damage per broken barrier and extra damage based on their max heallth. Also, gain Guard per level.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p](2) 1 Guard, 2 damage per broken Barrier + 3% Max health.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p](4) 2 Guard, 4 damage per broken barrier + 5% Max health.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p](6) 3 Guard, 6 damage per broken barrier + 8% Max health.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]
[b]New[/b][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]When one of your Barriers is broken, gain Thorns. If an enemy broke it, it receives damage based on its Max Health. Also, gain Guard per level.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p](2) 1 Guard, 2 Thorns and 3% Max Health damage.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p](4) 2 Guard, 3 Thorns and 6% Max Health damage.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p](6) 3 Guard, 4 Thorns and 10% Max Health damage.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the Aegis Mythic set (activated by Cyclopean Masterpiece) to now give you Thorns when damaged (instead of after losing Barriers or Armor) to better differentiate it from the new Ironclad.[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed the Taboo set to now deal extra damage based on the enemy Max Health.[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed the health restored from the Sudden Aging skill from 2 to 3.[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed the health restored from the Emergency Healing skill from 2 to 3.[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed the health restored from the Tempting Offer skill from 5 to 10.[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed the Damage Amplification gained with the Blood Sacrifice skill from 25% to 30%.[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed the Critical Damage given by the Opal Necklace from 40% to 30% (it was never intended to give the previous value).
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bugfixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The Avatar of The Corruption boss had a lot of bugs related to its End of Round logic. To fix that, we reworked its first two abilities to activate on even and odds turns respectively.

[b]Old
[/b]At the end of every 2nd round, summon a Corrupted Hero (if able).
At the end of every 3rd round, devour all Corrupted Heroes and gain their damage.
At the end of the 7th round, its damage doubles.

[b]New[/b][/p][p]At the end of every even round, summon a Corrupted Hero (if able).
At the end of every odd round other than the first, devour all Corrupted Heroes and gain their damage.
At the end of every 10th round, its damage doubles.[b]
[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the Spear of the Core enemy to not gain extra attacks when damaged. Its damage was nerfed from 3 to 2 to compensate.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the potions unlocked after beating the game for the first time to never appear.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that enabled the player to use the Hammer option at Shrines in level 3 items, wasting the effect without upgrading any item.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the Survival Instinct skill to reduce your Damage Amplification when you healed while being at full health, which even caused your attacks to heal enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that prevented negative Statuses on the player from being removed when entering the Incarnate boss fight.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the game to sometimes be softlocked after using a potion while the enemy was attacking.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the Ceremonial Rite skill to be unlocked from the start.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the Forge to prevent items being lost if you don't have enough inventory space.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a variety of visual bugs.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch - 09/03/2025
notes.content: [h3][b]Balance[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Buffed the Rage given by Legion from (3/4/5) to (3/5/8).[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed the Regeneration given by Darkthorn from (2/4/6) to (3/5/8).[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed the health% damage from Ironclad from (2%/4%/6%) to (3%/5%/8%).[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed the percentage of stunning an enemy from Taboo from (30%/50%) to (35%/55%).[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed the stun damage from Taboo from (10/15) to (20/30).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a variety of bugs affecting the Endless Mode, including boss rewards working as in the normal game instead of as intended and the first Passive Ability of Liz giving items of incorrect rarities.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a variety of errors in translated texts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual glitch affecting minions spawning in bossfights.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a failsafe to prevent achievements to never be unlocked in certain situations.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Hotfix - 06/27/2025
notes.content: [p]Fixed a bug that caused Swiftness to sometimes not trigger on the first attack of a combat.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Hotfix - 06/21/2025
notes.content: [p]Fixed a bug that caused some "When entering an Area" effects to not trigger when loading a game.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch - 06/19/2025 - Quality of life
notes.content: [p]This new patch focuses on improving the overall user experience through a better communication of some mechanics and the addition of new features to make the process of creating builds easier.[/p][p][/p][p][b]General[/b][/p][list][*][p]Items found in Golden Chests can now be rerolled once.[/p][/*][*][p]When obtaining an item, improved the chance of it being part of one of your active Equipment Sets.[/p][/*][*][p]When choosing a Style, improved the chance of finding a Style that matches your active Equipment Sets.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the visual clarity for items that can be upgraded.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the visiblity of Skill icons.[/p][/*][*][p]Damage of enemies is now shown on a different color when buffed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Balance[/b][/p][list][*][p]Items from the Ronin Set have been slightly buffed.[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrading items with Lifesteal now increases their Lifesteal more, but they start with lower base values.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Bugfixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused different problems when loading a game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Lifesteal in some languages to be correctly displayed on tooltips.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch - 06/07/2025 - New potions!
notes.content: [p]This new patch includes two new potions, localization for Russian (thanks to Nikita Mikhalev!), a much needed QoL feature to show which slot corresponds to each item and some fixes and small improvements to certain features of the game.[/p][p][/p][p][b]General[/b][/p][list][*][p]Russian localization added to the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Two new potions added to the pool: the Debilitating Potion, which applies 10 Weakness when dropped on an enemy and the Sickening Potion, which applies 10 Wound when dropped on an enemy.[/p][/*][*][p]Hovering an item now shows its Category, which determines the slot it can be equipped in.[/p][/*][*][p]Now the game uses a pixel font when displaying Chinese texts.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Bugfixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Some popups that were displayed in English even when playing in another language are now displayed in the correct language.[/p][/*][*][p]Now enemies stunned after losing a barrier correctly show the stunned animation.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Hotfix - 05/03/2025
notes.content: Fixed a bug that caused potions to permanently block the first slot they occupy.

notes.title: Demo Patch - 05/02/2025
notes.content:
In this patch we focused on improving the clarity of some elements of the game and fixing problems with the localization, mainly the Spanish one. Also, the new items that were intended for the previous patch are now correctly added, oops!

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved the presentation of the Info menu.
[*]Changed the colors of some Set icons to better differentiate between them.
[*]You can now leave the Skill Book event after acquiring a skill so you can inmediately benefit from skills that trigger when entering a new Area.
[*]Localized some elements that were still being shown in English while playing in other languages.
[*]Fixed some mistakes in the Spanish localization.
[*]Added two new Rare items to the Villager set: the Rusty Ring (Poisonous 2, Luck 5) and the Woodcutting Axe (Physical damage 5-10, Luck 5).
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug with the camera movement when the boss appears.
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented statuses applied with potions to benefit from Royal.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused potions to be stacked on top of other items sometimes.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Hotfix - 04/12/2025
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the Rogue effect still wasn't triggering correctly after the previous fix.
[*]Fixed a bug where if you clicked very fast to gather potions, the skip rewards button appeared in the next area, causing different problems.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Hotfix - 04/10/2025
notes.content: Fixed a bug in the Potion Area that caused one potion to disappear when picking the other one.

notes.title: Demo Patch - 04/09/2025 - New languages!
notes.content:
We have added new languages to Overlooting! You can now play in German, French, Spanish and Simplified Chinese. We will be adding more languages in the future so if yours is not supported yet don't worry. Also, we have added some much needed QoL features to the game, a change to the map structure, and more balance and bugfixing as usual.

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]German, French, Spanish and Simplified Chinese added to the game.
[*]Added a skip button so you don't have to take some rewards if you don't want them to take your inventory space.
[*]Added the option to reroll once when choosing a style.
[*]Changed the map structure: now forges appear later, when you have more items to forge, and the target dummy event appears before the shrine.
[*]Added two new Rare items to the Villager set: the Rusty Ring (Poisonous 3, 5 Luck) and the Woodcutting Axe (Physical damage 5-10, 5 Luck).
[/list]

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*]Slightly buffed the Enrage items that were nerfed in the previous patch.
[*]Beast damage percentage buffed from [10/25] to [10/30].
[*]Sylvan swiftness bonus buffed from [5/25/30] to [5/25/35].
[*]Forest-kin druid health nerfed from 30 to 25.
[*]Forest-kin warrior health nerfed from 25 to 20.
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Rogue effect to not trigger sometimes.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Sylvan to give less Swiftness than it should.
[/list]

Thanks to the Warloc team for the localization of the game, in particular to Christophe Pallarès (French), Simon Dehne (German), Albert Wei (Simplified Chinese) and Michael Stein (Project Lead).

notes.title: Demo Hotfix - 03/27/2025
notes.content: Fixed a bug that prevented the unlock of new Corruptions if Maximilian was at maximum level.

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes - 03/22/2025
notes.content:
This patch aims to even out a bit the difficulty curve and to continue improving the balance between items.

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] End of turn effects (like Poison) no longer trigger if you have cleared the Area.
[*] Now when you hover the sign at the forge it shows a tooltip that explains how the forge works.
[/list]
[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Items that give Enrage have been nerfed across the board.
[*] Lion Maw lifesteal nerfed to 2% from 3%.
[*] Beast damage nerfed from [15%/30%] to [10%/25%].
[*] Rogue critical chance nerfed from [5%/15%/25%] to [5%/12%/20%].
[*] Rogue critical damage nerfed from [5%/25%/50%] to [5%/20%/40%].
[*] Battle Frenzy no longer gives 1 Enrage.
[*] Adrenaline lose of damage amplification nerfed from 5% to 8%.
[*] Play Safe lose of critical damage buffed from 25% to 20%.
[*] Forbidden Helmet armor nerfed from 3 to 2.
[*] Tortobra health nerfed from 70 to 64.
[*] Warghark health nerfed from 62 to 60.
[*] Forest-kin Druid health buffed from 20 to 30.
[/list]
[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] You no longer stay alive if your health drops to 0 by the effect of Faceless.
[*] Faceless no longer nullifies Adrenaline damage amplification.
[*] Paralyzing Potion description is now correctly displayed.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Hotfix - 03/17/2025
notes.content: Fixed a bug that caused enemies (including the boss) killed by acid potions to stay alive at 0 health, preventing the game to continue.

notes.title: Demo Hotfix - 03/16/2025
notes.content: The fix to the bug that caused the demo locked skills to be displayed created another bug where all the skills where choosable from the start of the game, which created a lot of other problems. It should fixed now.

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes - 03/15/2025
notes.content:
In this first patch our main goals are to fix some important bugs and to improve the balance of the game.


[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased the likelihood of items looted being from a set you have activated.
[*]Increased experience gained after finishing a run.
[*]Changed some texts to improve their clarity.
[/list]
[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*]Sylvan swiftness bonus buffed to [5/25/30] from [5/20/25].
[*]Ironclad damage buffed to [3/6/9] from [2/4/6].
[*]Taboo damage buffed to [8/12] from [5/10].
[*]Legion damage reduction buffed to [15%/35%/50%] from [10%/30%/50%].
[*]Beast damage percentage nerfed to [15%/30%] from [30%/50%].
[*]Ronin set reworked to give a benefit every 3rd turn instead of every other turn depending on if it's odd or even.
[*]Emotional rage bonus buffed to 8 from 6.
[*]Play Safe critical chance bonus buffed to 50% from 45% and critical damage reduction buffed to 25% from 30%.
[*]Healthy Lifestyle max health bonus buffed to 30 from 20.
[*]Advanced Tactics damage bonus buffed to 100% from 50%.
[*]Adrenaline damage amplification bonus nerfed to 40% from 50%.
[*]Stealth Dagger critical chance nerfed to 8% from 10%.
[/list]
[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*]The King of the Forest will no longer stay alive at 0 health in certain situations.
[*]Sylvan set now correctly gives an extra 3% Damage amplification on attack at level 6.
[*]Royal now correctly gives extra Barrier stacks when gaining stacks from skills or set bonuses.
[*]Maximilian second passive ability now correctly increases forge uses.
[*]Damage amplification no longer applies twice in certain situations.
[*]Skills locked for the demo are no longer displayed when acquiring the skills of the previous level.
[/list]
